candidates.tagline: Apple's priciest phone can't make calls — fix requires a whole new phone
candidates.story: Apple's $1,299 iPhone 18 Pro Max has a hardware bug that permanently kills cellular service on AT&T networks; no software fix exists, so Apple is replacing every affected unit with an entirely new device.
candidates.why_funny: A phone that physically cannot phone people is the platonic ideal of 'it should work' — and the solution is to throw the phone away.
candidates.alt: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max smartphone in black titanium finish

candidates.tagline: Olympics committee leaked their own logo reveal to YouTube 3 days early
candidates.story: Brisbane 2032 Olympics organizers accidentally published their elaborate logo-reveal video on their own YouTube channel on Friday, ruining a months-long PR build-up — the emblem is a pink galah cockatoo, which in Australian slang means 'a fool'.
candidates.why_funny: They chose a bird that Australians call a fool as their emblem, then immediately proved the point by fouling up their own reveal — the logo picked perfectly.
candidates.alt: Pink galah cockatoo (rose-breasted cockatoo) perched on a branch, the species chosen as Brisbane 2032 Olympic emblem
